_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. me.sh declares no design-token CSS variables — its nine custom properties are Bulma column gaps and orb positions (raw/css-vars.json). Every leaf is a measured value resolved from raw/components-computed.json at build time. Two page themes exist: the dark marketing surface (dark) and the warm light pricing and sign-in surfaces (light).
